notes: Indicative checks (docs/plan-fem.md §12): the Eurocodes' recommended values (kept by the Romanian annexes where Lapin could read them) and CR 6-2013; the signed design remains the engineer's.
No wall or bracing along X: the frame looks unbraced (sway) that way. The buckling lengths assume a braced frame; give the columns' own (k > 1, analysis.setDesign ky / kz or lcrY / lcrZ).

EN 1993-1-1 5.2.1(3): αcr = 2.33 under „1.35 G1 + 1.5 S + 0.9 W+X/p”, below 10: second-order effects must be taken (analysis.setOptions secondOrder, or the sway effects × 1/(1 − 1/αcr) when αcr ≥ 3); analysis.buckling gives every combination's.
